data.name: Finegan
data.gender_notes: Finegan is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Irish name 'Fionnghuan', meaning 'white stranger' or 'fair-haired foreigner'. This name was borne by a legendary Irish hero and poet. It has been popular in Ireland and among Irish diaspora communities for centuries. The name Finegan carries the meaning “Fair, fine, handsome” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Finegan usually hope their child will grow to embody fair, fine, handsome and live with faith, good character and purpose.
